title: Multitrack import mapping
$comment: Generated from packages/contracts/src by npm run schemas. Do not edit. Stored as: recap-tracks.yaml next to the imported tracks, or --mapping (T05).

recorder.description: Provider that recorded the tracks. Must be campaign.yaml provider.recording (consent is per provider). Default: that provider.

origin_uncertainty_ms.description: Uncertainty of the provisional session origin (ADR-003). Default 0.

default_timing_uncertainty_ms.description: timing_uncertainty_ms for tracks that do not set one. Default 0.

file.description: File name of the track in the import directory (no sub-directories).

start_offset_ms.description: Session offset of the first sample of this track (ADR-003). Default 0: the track starts at session zero.

timing_uncertainty_ms.description: Bound on the error of start_offset_ms. Default: the mapping default.

label.description: Track label recorded in fragments.jsonl. Default: the file name.
